title: ‘We love Wemby’: San Antonio embraces French star ahead of NBA Finals
summary: Since Frenchman Victor “Wemby” Wembanyama came to San Antonio, locals say the Spurs have opened a new chapter and are confident the young basketballer will help the team secure a sixth title in the upcoming NBA final.
